# AI to the Summit

> Multilingual AI companion for trekkers, tourists and rescue teams in remote mountainous regions — trail guidance, live weather alerts, GPS-based SOS and offline emergency resources.

AI to the Summit is an AI-powered mountain safety platform combining a conversational assistant, real-time GPS + weather awareness, and an offline emergency toolkit designed for high-altitude and low-connectivity environments.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Product overview, features, live chat demo and about section.
- [AI Emergency Triage](/triage): Step-by-step AI triage flow with live GPS, weather/hazard alerts, SOS report generation and rescue status timeline.
- [Offline Emergency Resources](/offline-resources): First-aid guides, emergency contacts, survival checklist and locally-saved SOS draft for use without connectivity.
